layout: app/modules/resource_intake/ — called by build guardrails (tools/checks/resource_intake_check.py) and admin tools. Writes the compiled Information Composer resource pool to data/composer_resources.json. Does not render tenant-facing output.

input_audit.note: Submitted by a human operator via the intake API or build tool; schema-validated.
Human approver name recorded at approval time; hard gate, cannot be empty.
Defaults to data/composer_resources.json relative to the project root.

preview_state: Operator/admin sees the staged candidate with fact-check status and approval state before releasing.
review_state: Operator/admin sees the updated compiled pool with the new approved resource listed and a generated timestamp.
output_how: Pydantic validation followed by JSON dump to data/composer_resources.json.
output_where: data/composer_resources.json on disk; read by the Information Composer at runtime.
output_why: Provides the Information Composer with a human-verified, non-AI-generated resource pool that satisfies the Part 3 sourcing contract.
process_description: Ingests a candidate resource, validates it against the sourcing contract, tracks fact-check and human-approval states, and writes approved resources to a compiled JSON pool.
process_context: Runs when an operator/admin submits a candidate resource for the Information Composer or when the build guardrail validates the compiled pool.

narrative_events.context_clause: because a new source was submitted for the Composer
because a human verifier confirmed the source
because it was marked as AI-generated or failed fact-check
